description: Cryptographic keys are not managed throughout their lifecycle including generation, distribution, storage, and revocation. This signal indicates that weak key management may compromise cryptographic protections.
applicability: Applicable to all cryptographic key usage. Includes key generation, key storage, key distribution, key rotation, and key revocation procedures.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through key management procedure review, key storage security assessment, and key lifecycle verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
